feeds.title: Living With Thanksgiving
feeds.description: Hi, I am Bonnie from Living with Thanksgiving. I stand in awe of God's Faithfulness to me and His mercies are new every morning. I enjoy traveling, gardening, tablescaping, photography, entertaining, decorating, and blogging about family and friends. Join me as I share my latest adventures.

feeds.title: The Recipe Rebel » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: All the recipes you need for your Thanksgiving dinner! Fall favorites from turkey to mashed potatoes to side dishes and dinner rolls. Don't forget about Thanksgiving desserts! From pie to pumpkin, we have it all. Authored by Ashley Fehr, a food addict who loves creating easy meals her family loves.

feeds.title: Julie's Eats & Treats » Thanksgiving Recipes
feeds.description: A blog section covering Thanksgiving Recipes by Julie Evink. Prepare your Thanksgiving meal with these family-favorite traditional Thanksgiving recipes! You'll turn to these recipes every year.

feeds.title: 31 Daily » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: Thanksgiving how-tos and recipe ideas that will inspire a beautiful Thanksgiving dinner. Whether you're hosting or bringing dishes to grandma's house, you'll get fresh ideas for fall centerpieces, Thanksgiving menus, and even the front porch! Blog by Stephanie Wilson.

feeds.title: From My Bowl » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: Thanksgiving vegan recipes that are easy-to-follow and budget-friendly. Authored by Caitlin Shoemaker, the photographer, videographer, and recipe developer behind From My Bowl.

feeds.title: Love Bakes Good Cakes » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: Covers delicious and simple family-friendly Thanksgiving meals. Created by Jamie Sherman, Love Bakes Good Cakes Blog features everything from healthier recipes to over-the-top desserts!

feeds.title: Flavor the Moments » Thanksgiving Recipes
feeds.description: Thanksgiving recipes that have been tried and true for years!For a smaller gathering, look for spatchcock turkey and traditional sides like green bean casserole, mashed potatoes, and turkey gravy! Written by Marcie Bidou.

feeds.title: I Am Homesteader » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: This blog represents one family's desire to intentionally rely more on the land and the tools God gave us. Amanda Rettke is a Homesteader who contributes to this blog section with Thanksgiving recipes.

feeds.title: Salt & Baker » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: A thanksgiving recipe archive that has everything you need to make your Turkey day delicious and extra special! Woo your guests with our delicious Thanksgiving stuffing recipe, sweet potato casserole, roasted Brussels sprouts with bacon, and desserts like praline pumpkin pie and French silk pie. Blog by Whitney Wright.

feeds.title: Kudos Kitchen by Renee » Thanksgiving Recipes
feeds.description: Delicious Thanksgiving recipes featuring everyone's favorite, appetizers, drinks, sides, and main course options. These Thanksgiving recipes are family tested and approved and have been given a solid two-thumbs-up rating by Renee's family of picky eaters.

feeds.title: I am a food blog » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: I am a Food Blog is a recipe & travel blog written by husband and wife team Mike & Steph. In its 7 years of existence, it has covered such diverse subjects as mini beef wellingtons, driving through Iceland's ring road, and making pho in a pressure cooker. Follow this feed for thanksgiving recipes and much more.

feeds.title: Brooklyn Active Mama » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: Nellie is an NYC-based busy mom, shares top fitness, workout, travel, and parenting tips for moms and busy women. Here, you can find her Thanksgiving Recipes.

feeds.title: The Chopping Block » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: Blog for thanksgiving recipes, cooking tips, and techniques as well as our staff's favorite eats and travel adventures. The Chopping Block is Chicago's premier cooking school & gourmet retail store with food-friendly wines & a private event venue for social & corporate parties

feeds.title: Let Them Eat Gluten Free Cake » Thanksgiving Recipes
feeds.description: This is your one stop shop for all the Gluten-Free Thanksgiving Recipes you will ever need to enjoy the biggest food holiday with your family. Kim started this blog to share her gluten-free baking and cooking success stories with you.

feeds.title: The Penny Pantry » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: Features vegan and plant-based recipes for Thanksgiving written by Amy Parr. She started this website in hopes to help other people reduce their monthly grocery expenses.

feeds.title: More Momma! » Thanksgiving
feeds.description: A hub for busy families to learn easy recipes and gain newfound confidence in the kitchen. In this section, Author Megan Dow writes about simple, easy, and delicious Thanksgiving meals to feed your body and soul.

feeds.title: Kalejunkie » Thanksgiving
